do_more: Cover mind-bending Indian architectural marvels with real engineering explanations like stepwells and floating pillars
Focus on extreme geography anomalies such as towns underground or places with zero sunlight
Use strong visual side-by-side reveals within the first 1.5 seconds to minimize swipe-away rate
Pace narration tightly under 40 seconds to maximize watched percentage and complete loops
avoid: Starting videos with slow introductions, greetings, or channel intros
Covering generic textbook facts without an unexpected twist or hidden secret angle
Touching sensitive religious or mythological debates that risk community guideline issues
Using static stock imagery without panning, zooming, or dynamic motion graphics
hook_tips: Start immediately with a counter-intuitive statement: 'Duniya ka ek aisa desh jahan...' without saying hello
